edits.before: - Alistar Headbutt: matchup-defining — The headbutt-pulverize combo starts every play — respect flash range while it is up. Read it before every duo step-up. - Your W Prismatic Barrier answers exactly one disaster per cooldown. - Spend the R on swing moments only.
edits.after: - Headbutt (W) and Pulverize (Q) both run a 14/13/12/11/10s cooldown — whichever he opens with, that side is down for the full window. Read it before every duo step-up. - Trample (E) is 12/11.5/11/10.5/10s and stacks toward a stun auto. - Your W Prismatic Barrier answers exactly one disaster per cooldown. - Spend the R on swing moments only.

edits.before: E the contact, detonate, passive-auto, bank the Q visibly — the chip is free and the threat governs.
edits.after: His passive heals him and nearby allies once fully charged by CC or a nearby death — chip poke means little once it pops, so time your all-in for right after he spends the charge, or pair kills with anti-heal.

edits.before: Q-poking on cooldown until the hook learns the rhythm — the binding is the lane's law; spend it like one.
edits.after: Trample (E) resets his auto-attack when it procs — the wind-up before that swing is your cue to back off, not the cast itself; eating it just stacks him toward the stun faster.
